svg.title: RPE simultaneously updates two targets: basal ganglia pathway weights and episodic memory
svg.desc: Positive RPE reinforces the BG pathway that was used and writes a high-salience episodic memory. Negative RPE suppresses the pathway and writes a high-salience warning memory. Both updates happen after every execution.

g.text: pathway weight ↑ · more likely next time
pathway weight ↓ · less likely next time
salience = f(drive intensities at this moment)
high RPE moment → high salience memory
the two updates are complementary: BG weight change affects future selection (implicit).
episodic memory write affects future reasoning context (explicit).
together they ensure the agent improves both its habits and its understanding.
